response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count FROM disp AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp AS x WHERE x.account_id = d.account_id AND x.type = 'DISPONENT');

assumptions.assumption: A non-disponent account has no disposition row with type 'DISPONENT'.

alternatives.interpretation: Count disposition rows whose own type is not 'DISPONENT', even if their account also has a disponent.
alternatives.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count FROM disp WHERE type <> 'DISPONENT';
